metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-39. - Paying unpaid installment payments.
content.summary:
An owner of property, who has elected to pay by installment payments on a promissory
               note, may at any time pay the balance of the promissory note. Failure to pay any installment
               when due shall cause the whole amount of the unpaid balance to become due and payable
      …

faqs.a:
An owner of property, who has elected to pay by installment payments on a promissory
               note, may at any time pay the balance of the promissory note. Failure to pay any installment
               when due shall cause the whole amount of the unpaid balance to become due and payable
               immediately at the option of the city.
(
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, 11-19-2012
)
